title: Prime Minister shares an article highlighting India’s rapidly evolving deep-tech capabilities
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, today shared an article by Chief Scientist of Zoho, Shri Sridhar Vembu, highlighting how India’s rapidly evolving deep-tech capability owes much to the Prime Minister’s vision and commitment.
Shri Modi said that the article highlights how semiconductors, space, defence and AI are building capabilities and know-how, noting that India is now choosing to do more of the difficult learning itself.
The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X:
“Chief Scientist of @zoho, Shri @svembu writes that India's rapidly evolving deep-tech capability owes much to PM @narendramodi's vision and commitment.
He highlights how semiconductors, space, defence and AI are building capabilities and know-how, saying India is now choosing to do more of the difficult learning itself.”
